_comment: The Google Cloud Chirp 3 HD voice roster. Voice ids are the suffix after `ja-JP-Chirp3-HD-`. This file is the roster `scripts/validate-voices.mjs` gates against — a voice assigned in shared/characters.json that isn't listed here fails the build. Refresh with `npm run voices:verify-roster` (needs GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY); never hand-add a name you haven't seen come back from voices.list.
